description: Kit for Inkrun, an AI ad agent that pulls one brief through 31 ad platforms like a blacklit gig-poster print shop: 16 dashboard icons, 3D ink-brayer and edition-stamp heroes, six feature cards, print-run launch and customer-story banners, a how-it-works film, a new-platform announcement, a live-event countdown, a holiday greeting, and animated carousel-press and ink-exchange scenes.
